# Base image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS for a stable and widely supported environment
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set non-interactive frontend for package installations to avoid prompts
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install build dependencies, MPI, git, and certificates
# - build-essential: Provides C/C++ compilers (gcc, g++) and make
# - git: For cloning the source code repository
# - ca-certificates: Required for secure network communications (e.g., git clone over https)
# - openmpi-bin & libopenmpi-dev: OpenMPI runtime and development libraries for parallel computing
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    git \
    make \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized/cloud environments (like Kubernetes)
# This forces MPI to use the standard TCP network interface (eth0) inside the container,
# preventing it from trying to find specialized HPC interconnects (like InfiniBand) which don't exist.
RUN echo "btl_tcp_if_include = eth0" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    echo "oob_tcp_if_include = eth0" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf

# Clone, build, and install the amg2023 application in a single layer
# FIX: 'make' is run first in the project root to build the required libraries,
# then in the 'test' directory to build the 'amg' executable, resolving linker errors.
# The executable is copied to /usr/local/bin to be on the system PATH.
# The source code is removed post-build to minimize image size.
RUN git clone https://github.com/LLNL/AMG.git /tmp/amg2023_build && \
    cd /tmp/amg2023_build && \
    make && \
    cd test && \
    make && \
    cp amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /tmp/amg2023_build

# Set a default working directory for the container
WORKDIR /data

# Define a default command to be executed when the container starts.
# Running 'amg' without arguments typically shows usage information.
CMD ["amg"]

# This MiniCluster manifest is designed to run the AMG2023 benchmark
# on a single Kubernetes node, suitable for an AWS CPU instance environment.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # A descriptive name for the MiniCluster experiment.
  name: amg2023-problem2-test
  # The MiniCluster will be deployed in the 'default' namespace.
spec:
  # The total number of pods to create for the job.
  # We are running on a single node as requested.
  size: 1

  # The total number of MPI ranks (tasks) to run.
  # This will run 4 ranks inside the single pod.
  tasks: 4

  # For debugging purposes, do not delete the pods upon job completion.
  cleanup: false

  # Enforce strict schema validation for the MiniCluster spec.
  logging:
    strict: true

  # Defines the application container to be run by Flux.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023

      # This container is a worker, not a standalone launcher.
      # The operator handles launching the job within the pod.
      launcher: false

      # The command to execute inside the container.
      # The Flux operator will automatically wrap this with 'flux run'.
      # This runs AMG with problem 2 and a small test size of 4x4x4.
      command: test_amg -problem 2 -n 4 4 4

# This corrected MiniCluster manifest runs the AMG2023 benchmark.
# The fix addresses the previous failure by using the correct executable name 'amg'
# instead of 'test_amg', as identified from the error analysis.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # A descriptive name for the corrected MiniCluster experiment.
  name: amg2023-problem2-test-fixed
spec:
  # The total number of pods to create for the job.
  # As requested, the job runs on a single node.
  size: 1

  # The total number of MPI ranks (tasks) to run across all pods.
  # With size: 1, all 4 tasks will run in the single pod.
  tasks: 4

  # For debugging, the job pods will not be deleted upon completion.
  cleanup: false

  # Enforce strict schema validation for this MiniCluster definition.
  logging:
    strict: true

  # Defines the application container to be managed by Flux.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023

      # This container is a worker; the Flux operator will handle the launch.
      launcher: false

      # Corrected command to execute. The Flux operator wraps this with 'flux run'.
      # Runs AMG with problem set 2 and a small 4x4x4 test size.
      command: amg -problem 2 -n 4 4 4

# This manifest corrects critical YAML syntax errors that caused the previous deployment to fail.
# Invalid keys in 'nodeSelector' and 'environment' have been fixed, allowing the pod to be scheduled.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # Name for the optimized experimental run.
  name: amg2023-problem2-opt-run2
spec:
  # The job will run within a single pod.
  size: 1
  # The job will run with 64 MPI tasks.
  tasks: 64
  # Pods will not be deleted after the job completes to allow for log inspection.
  cleanup: false
  logging:
    quiet: true

  # Flux-specific configuration for the ARM architecture.
  flux:
    arch: arm
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # Pod scheduling configuration.
  pod:
    nodeSelector:
      # FIX: Corrected a syntax error by removing an extraneous quote from the key.
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: m7g.16xlarge

  # Main application container definition.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
      # The command runs a larger problem size suitable for the target node.
      command: amg -problem 2 -n 32 32 32 -P 8 4 2
      # This container is a worker; the operator handles the launch.
      launcher: false
      environment:
        # FIX: Corrected a syntax error by removing an extraneous quote from the key.
        OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism: cma
        OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"

apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: amg2023-problem2-opt-run3
spec:
  cleanup: false
  containers:
  - command: amg -problem 2 -n 64 64 64 -P 8 4 2
    environment:
      OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism: cma
      OMP_NUM_THREADS: '1'
    image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
    launcher: false
  flux:
    arch: arm
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9
  logging:
    quiet: true
    strict: true
  pod:
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: m7g.16xlarge
  size: 1
  tasks: 64

manager.name: Build and Deploy AMG2023
manager.description: Build a Docker container and deploy it as a Kubernetes Job.

context.details: Clone the latest branch of amg2023. You MUST put amg on the PATH.

context.optimize:
Maximize the amg2023 figure of merit. You MUST maximize memory per CPU core. More cores are better.
The trick to optimizing this is THREADING. You MUST force OpenMP and any math libraries to use only one thread per MPI rank. On example is setting OMP_NUM_THREADS to "1". You might also consider setting OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism to "cma" as a conservative builder will set to none.
YOU MUST SLOWLY increase the problem size, one dimension at a time, by an increment no more than double the current to increase the FOM. A timeout may not require a smaller problem size but rather a different instance.
A previous run example that has worked well:
  amg -problem 2 -n 128 128 128 -P 8 4 1 on m7g.16xlarge with FOM 8.039496e+08
The size of the MiniCluster MUST be 1. Tasks MUST be at least 4.
To reduce noise in logging, you can set logging.quiet to true.
context.resources:
The resource spec you got earlier is for an autoscaling cluster, so the nodes possible are not there. For your optimization you can choose from the following instance types, and you will need to add the correct nodeSelector with the node.kubernetes.io/instance-type label indicating your choice. You are still limited to one node.      
  c7a.12xlarge, 48 CPU, 96 GiB Memory, AMD
  hpc7g.16xlarge, 64 CPU, 128 GiB Memory, ARM (Graviton3)
  c6in.12xlarge, 24 CPU, 96 GiB Memory, Intel

  c6id.12xlarge, 24 CPU, 96 GiB Memory, Intel

  m6a.12xlarge, 24 CPU, 192 GiB Memory, AMD

ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9. Otherwise, do not change or set it.
If you are using an ARM instance you MUST also set flux.arch: "arm".
context.testing:
You MUST run AMG -problem 2. For testing choose a small problem size no greater than 4 in any dimension.    
If you see a nodeSelector and larger size in the manifest it is OK to keep that and try to debug the issue.
